text: Wata on waɗtitir ahadi Alla ndin jawkal fanɗungel e firtugol ndi ronka hunnude ndi. Anndee ko ko woni ka Alla kon immorde e ballal, e teetateeri aduna, e ko woni ka Makko laakara kon immorde e neemaa- ji duumotooɗi, ko ɗum ɓuri moƴƴande on e dii ko waɗtirton e coggu fanɗungu fii firtugol ahadi, si tawno hiɗon anndi ɗum!
